attempts.edit: Fix the two terminal-state transitions (s6 and sf6) so that the first bit of the next non-overlapping 6-bit group is classified correctly: a 0 must enter s1 (first-bit-matched) and a 1 must enter sf1 (first-bit-failed). Both states currently route the opposite way (data?s1:sf1), which misclassifies the group that begins after a terminal state and yields not_match instead of match for a following 0
